skills.name: backend-express
skills.description: Express.js TypeScript API architecture with layered routes/controllers/services, Zod validation, async error middleware, and security headers. Use when building lightweight Node REST APIs or BFFs. Not for NestJS apps.

skills.name: backend-mongodb
skills.description: MongoDB document schema design, ESR indexing, aggregation pipelines, and query optimization. Use when modeling collections, writing aggregations, or tuning MongoDB queries. Not for relational SQL/Postgres.

skills.name: backend-nestjs
skills.description: NestJS modular architecture, dependency injection boundaries, DTO validation, guards/interceptors, and testing. Use when building or refactoring NestJS backend services. Not for Express or frontend apps.

skills.name: backend-postgresql
skills.description: PostgreSQL schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, migrations, and connection pooling. Use when writing SQL, designing Postgres schemas, or tuning slow queries. Not for NoSQL/MongoDB.

skills.name: desktop-electron-shell
skills.description: Secure Electron app shell - main/preload/renderer split, contextBridge IPC, validation, windows and tooling (electron-vite). Use when Node.js native modules or the Node ecosystem are required. Prefer Tauri when footprint matters.

skills.name: desktop-native-menus-shortcuts
skills.description: Native menu bar, tray icon, keyboard shortcuts and a command palette for desktop apps, with platform conventions (Cmd vs Ctrl). Use for any real desktop application.

skills.name: desktop-packaging-updates
skills.description: Build, sign, notarize, package and auto-update desktop apps with a CI release matrix (Tauri bundler or electron-builder). Use when shipping to users.

skills.name: desktop-tauri-shell
skills.description: Tauri 2 app shell - project setup, window config, Rust commands via invoke, capabilities (least privilege), CSP and sidecars. Use for small, fast desktop apps. Not when the main process needs the Node ecosystem (use desktop-electron-shell).

skills.name: mobile-expo-scaffold
skills.description: Scaffold a React Native app with Expo, Expo Router, TypeScript and EAS. Use once at the start of a mobile project. Not for existing apps or bare native projects.

skills.name: mobile-flutter-dart
skills.description: Flutter 3 and Dart 3 app architecture, Riverpod/BLoC state, GoRouter navigation, const widget composition, and testing. Use when building Flutter mobile apps. Not for React Native/Expo projects.

skills.name: mobile-navigation
skills.description: Navigation with Expo Router - stacks, tabs, modals/sheets, deep links and auth gating. Use for any multi-screen mobile app.

skills.name: mobile-offline-storage
skills.description: Local persistence and offline support for React Native - MMKV, expo-sqlite, TanStack Query cache persistence, secure storage and a sync queue. Use when the app must work offline or cache data.

skills.name: mobile-reanimated-gestures
skills.description: 60fps UI-thread animation and gestures with react-native-reanimated and gesture-handler - sheets, swipe, drag, shared transitions. Use for gestures or complex animation. Not for simple fades handled by built-ins.

skills.name: shared-api-client
skills.description: Typed API client with zod parsing at the boundary, a consistent error model, retries, auth token handling and TanStack Query hooks. Use when the app talks to an HTTP API.

skills.name: shared-design-tokens
skills.description: Create the single source of design tokens (color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion) with semantic layers and dark mode, exported as CSS variables (web/desktop) or a theme object (mobile). Use at the start of any UI project.

skills.name: shared-dsa-and-simplicity
skills.description: Choose the simplest data structure and algorithm for each app section without over-engineering. Use when implementing search, caching, trees, queues, lookups, or data transforms. Not for trivial 1-to-1 CRUD.

skills.name: shared-state-management
skills.description: Decide where state lives - server cache (TanStack Query), client state (Zustand), URL state and local component state. Use when state crosses sections or screens. Not for trivial local state.

skills.name: shared-testing
skills.description: Testing strategy and setup per platform - Vitest + Playwright (web, desktop UI), Jest + React Native Testing Library + Maestro (mobile). Use for sections with logic, forms or flows. Skip for throwaway prototypes.

skills.name: shared-typescript
skills.description: TypeScript strict mode patterns, discriminated unions, unknown narrowing, and Zod boundary validation. Use when configuring tsconfig, typing APIs/state, or eliminating any/unsafe casts. Not for non-TS projects.

skills.name: web-app-scaffold
skills.description: Scaffold a new website or web app - choose framework, create folders, configure TypeScript, lint, tokens and env. Use once at project start. Not for projects that already have a scaffold.

skills.name: web-forms-validation
skills.description: Accessible forms with react-hook-form + zod, client and server validation, spam protection and designed states. Use for contact, signup, checkout, newsletter and settings forms.

skills.name: web-gsap-scrolltrigger
skills.description: GSAP + ScrollTrigger for scroll-triggered reveals, pinned sections, parallax, horizontal scroll and text splitting. Use for scroll-linked animation that is not video scrubbing. Not for simple CSS transitions.

skills.name: web-hero-section
skills.description: Compose the first viewport of a website - headline hierarchy, one primary CTA, supporting media and LCP-safe loading. Use for any hero or above-the-fold section. For scroll-scrubbed hero video also use web-scroll-scrubbed-video.

skills.name: web-image-optimization
skills.description: Optimized images for the web - AVIF/WebP, responsive sizes, LCP priority, blur placeholders, SVG usage. Use for hero images, galleries and cards. Not for video (see scroll-scrubbed-video) or sites with no images.

skills.name: web-nextjs
skills.description: Next.js App Router architecture, Server vs Client Components, streaming, Server Actions, and caching. Use when building Next.js routes, layouts, data fetching, or API handlers. Not for pure client-side SPAs.

skills.name: web-react
skills.description: React 19 component composition, state colocation, and render performance. Use when building React UIs, refactoring prop-heavy components, or fixing waterfalls/re-renders. Not for framework routing (use web-nextjs).

skills.name: web-responsive-layout
skills.description: Mobile-first responsive layout system - container, grid, fluid type, spacing and breakpoints. Use when building or fixing page layout at any size. Not needed for single fixed-size components.

skills.name: web-scroll-scrubbed-video
skills.description: Scroll-scrubbed video driven bidirectionally by GSAP ScrollTrigger, with FFmpeg all-intra (every frame a keyframe) encoding. Use for hero or showcase sections where scrolling up and down must play video frame-by-frame. Not for autoplay or looping background video.

skills.name: web-seo-metadata
skills.description: SEO and metadata for public websites - titles, descriptions, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, semantic headings. Use for marketing and content sites. Not for internal tools behind login.

skills.name: web-smooth-scroll-lenis
skills.description: Site-wide smooth scrolling with Lenis, synced to GSAP ScrollTrigger. Use when the user wants an inertial, premium scroll feel. Not for docs/accessibility-first sites or pages with many nested scroll containers.
